# `nlink-lab ip`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Show IP addresses assigned to a node

Usage: nlink-lab ip [OPTIONS] <LAB> <NODE>

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name

  <NODE>
          Node name

Options:
      --iface <IFACE>
          Filter by interface name

      --cidr
          Show CIDR notation (include prefix length)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
